description:
Software Engineer 

 SecurityMetrics is seeking a capable, forward-thinking Software Engineer to join our software engineering team. We value engineers who embrace modern software development practices and recognize that AI tools are transforming how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained. We believe that successful software engineering requires more than writing code. It requires thoughtful design, sound engineering judgment, automated testing, security awareness, effective collaboration, code review, and a commitment to the long-term health of our software. 

 In this role, you will design, build, test, and maintain secure, high-performing software components across our product portfolio. We expect our engineers to leverage modern AI coding tools and autonomous agents to accelerate velocity, expand test coverage, and improve code quality, while maintaining rigorous engineering judgment and critical code evaluation at every step. 

 Main Duties & Responsibilities 

 Software Development & Architecture 

 
 Design & Implementation: Design, code, test, and maintain high-quality software applications and components working across web, desktop, and mobile platforms. 

 Requirement Translation: Translate functional requirements and technical specifications into clean, efficient, secure, and maintainable code. 

 Task Decomposition: Efficiently break down complex software features into structured, manageable components suitable for AI-assisted implementation and modular development. 

 Maintenance & Optimization: Debug, troubleshoot, and refactor existing applications, addressing security vulnerabilities, outdated dependencies, and technical debt. 

 
 AI Integration & Modern Development Workflows 

 
 AI Tool Utilization: Actively leverage AI coding assistants and agentic development environments for code generation, explanation, refactoring, test creation, documentation, and technical research. 

 Agentic Workflows: Utilize AI agents to analyze codebases, plan multi-file implementation steps, construct task backlogs, and automate execution workflows. 

 Critical Evaluation: Critically audit all AI-generated output for correctness, security, performance, and adherence to architectural standards. Never accept AI output without validation through independent testing and code analysis. 

 Security & Data Compliance: Ensure all AI tool usage strictly complies with company policies regarding proprietary source code, customer data, and intellectual property. 

 
 Engineering Quality & Best Practices 

 
 Automated Testing: Take full ownership of code quality by writing comprehensive unit and integration tests, using AI tools to expand test scenarios and edge-case coverage. 

 Code Review & Git Workflows: Participate actively in peer code reviews, pull requests, and Git-based collaborative workflows, holding AI-generated code to the same high standards as human-authored code. 

 Shift-Left Security: Adopt shift-left engineering principles by identifying security concerns, performance bottlenecks, and architectural defects early in the development lifecycle. 

 CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Work within established Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure safe and frequent software deployments. 

 
 Collaboration & Professional Ownership 

 
 Cross-Functional Teamwork: Collaborate closely with developers, QA engineers, product managers, and security analysts to deliver reliable software solutions. 

 Technical Communication: Clearly articulate technical decisions, architectural trade-offs, and implementation strategies—including defending AI-assisted development choices. 

 End-to-End Ownership: Take full accountability for assigned features from concept to production, ensuring high quality regardless of whether AI tools were utilized. 

 Continuous Learning: Rapidly learn and adopt new programming languages, frameworks, security standards, and emerging AI technologies. 

 
 Qualifications & Skills 

 Required Qualifications 

 
 Education / Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical software development experience. 

 Programming Proficiency: Demonstrated proficiency writing software in modern programming languages such as Go, Python, JavaScript, and SQL. 

 Core Computer Science Fundamentals: Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and software architecture. 

 Source Control & Workflows: Practical experience with Git-based source control, branching strategies, pull requests, and peer code reviews. 

 AI Tool Readiness: Demonstrated experience with or strong commitment to adopting AI-assisted development tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, agentic environments) into daily workflows. 

 Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong debugging skills and the ability to solve complex technical problems systematically. 

 
 Preferred Experience 

 
 Experience building and maintaining applications across web, desktop, or mobile platforms. 

 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and automated deployment processes. 

 Knowledge of security industry standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., PCI DSS, NIST, SOC 1, SOC 2). 

 Advanced skills in context management, prompt engineering, and guiding autonomous AI agents through complex codebases. 

 
 About SecurityMetrics 

 At SecurityMetrics, we help organizations identify and close security and compliance gaps to prevent data breaches and protect sensitive information. For over two decades, SecurityMetrics has provided industry-leading security and compliance technology and services to businesses worldwide. 

 Our engineering team develops and maintains the core software driving our vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, PCI compliance, cardholder data discovery, and PII discovery tools. We operate in a fast-paced, high-security environment that prioritizes reliability, continuous innovation, and modern software engineering practices. 

 For more information, visit www.securitymetrics.com .
